"Kal baarish hogi."
"Nahi hogi."
"Thodi hogi."
"Shaam tak hogi."
Aur phir... dhoop nikal aati hai.
Ever wondered what actually happens inside the Weather Department before they give us the forecast?
Meet Hamza as Badal Singh - the manager who believes forecasting the weather is less about science... and more about vibes, gut feeling, office politics, and pure confidence.
From impossible predictions to bizarre logic that somehow becomes official announcements, this mockumentary takes you inside the most chaotic office you'll ever see this monsoon.
